segments.title: 第28章 兩女見面
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 28 The Two Girls Meet

Around three in the afternoon, Lin Xiufeng drove into the entrance of the Bi Hai Lan Ting residential complex, arriving downstairs at Building 12.

Lin Xiuhong got out of the car first and waved to Ying Chanxi, "Xixi, let's go up first. We can just let them carry the luggage."

"Oh, okay." Ying Chanxi nodded, but she still grabbed her own and Li Luo's schoolbags, slinging one on her back and one on her front, and then hugged that huge panda doll of hers.

Seeing the doll, Lin Xiuhong couldn't help but laugh, "I sort of remember this thing."

"I think it was the year Li Luo graduated from elementary school. We went shopping at the mall, and you could enter a prize draw for every 100 yuan spent."

"Li Luo drew three times and won this first prize. His luck was unbelievably good."

"Huh?" Hearing this, Ying Chanxi's footsteps paused for a moment. "...Is, is that what happened?"

She remembered Li Luo knocking on her door with a mysterious look on his face, saying he had prepared a special surprise for her.

Ying Chanxi had thought it was a graduation gift Li Luo had bought specifically for her.

"Mom, let's not bring this stuff up again." Li Luo said from behind, dragging Ying Chanxi's two large suitcases. "A true hero doesn't boast about past glories, don't you get it?"

Li Luo still remembered this very clearly.

Back at the prize draw, Li Luo had actually preferred the second prize, a Transformers model. But as bad luck would have it, he won the first prize, a stuffed panda.

A doll was a doll, and Li Luo was quite happy when he first got it.

But after taking it home, he put it on his bed and felt it was both cramped and hot when he slept.

So he started to despise the doll.

But it was a prize he had won, after all, and he couldn't just waste it. So Li Luo simply gave it to Ying Chanxi, which could be considered giving the doll a better home.

Around that time, Lin Xiuhong had specifically told Ying Chanxi to keep an eye on Li Luo and not let him play on the computer all day.

But ever since Li Luo gave her the panda doll, Ying Chanxi's supervision had relaxed considerably, allowing Li Luo to game to his heart's content for a whole summer vacation.

You win some, you lose some, I guess.

The group took their luggage into the elevator and went all the way up to the 15th floor.

Lin Xiuhong walked to the door of 1502, took a set of keys from her bag, and pushed the door open as she entered, saying, "I had four keys made. You and Xixi take one each, and I'll keep the other two."

"Besides you two, there's another young lady living here. You can consider her your senior."

"I met her once when I came by before. You two should get to know each other later. You'll be living under the same roof from now on, so discuss things if anything comes up, understand?"

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi both responded in agreement and took the keys from Lin Xiuhong.

Afterward, Li Luo, along with Lin Xiufeng and Zhao Rongjun, went downstairs to bring up the rest of the luggage.

A pile of luggage was gathered in the living room, and Lin Xiuhong had originally intended to help tidy up.

But just then, Lin Xiufeng received a call.

"Hello?"

"Right now? Is it that urgent?"

"Alright then, I'll be there in about... yeah, twenty minutes."

After hanging up, Lin Xiufeng spread his hands helplessly toward his older sister, "Something came up at the company, a delivery needs to be made. I have to go get busy. How about I take you home first?"

"It's fine, you go ahead." Lin Xiuhong waved her hand. "I'll help them unpack."

"There's nothing to unpack." Li Luo shook his head, pushing his mom's shoulders toward the door. "We're not kids anymore, we can manage on our own. Mom, just have Uncle take you back."

"Then what about dinner?" Lin Xiuhong was pushed to the doorway and couldn't help but ask, "I was thinking of cooking a meal for you."

"We can handle it ourselves, don't worry." Li Luo coaxed his mom out the door. Before they parted, he said to his uncle, "I'll leave it to you to take Mom home then, Uncle. Bye-bye."

"Alright, you guys take care of yourselves." Lin Xiufeng smiled, well aware of his nephew's thoughts.

Finally moving out to live on their own, having their own little world with a few good friends, of course they wouldn't want their parents hanging around and bothering them.

So Lin Xiufeng also chimed in to help, pulling his sister along to leave.

In the living room, after seeing his mom off, Li Luo stretched his back comfortably.

He glanced toward the small hallway. One of the room doors was closed; that should be the senior tenant's bedroom.

The other doors were all open, including two secondary bedrooms, a bathroom, and the master bedroom at the end of the hall.

"Which room do you want?" Li Luo turned his head to ask Ying Chanxi. "How about you take the master bedroom?"

Li Luo didn't have high requirements for his room. A bed was good enough, so giving the master bedroom to Ying Chanxi was no big deal.

But Ying Chanxi didn't reply immediately. Instead, she began to inspect the apartment.

First, she walked into the two secondary bedrooms to have a look.

Although the rooms weren't as large as her bedroom at home, they were definitely big enough, and there was even space for a small desk by the window.

Then she went into the master bedroom. There was a spacious double bed, two huge floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, a large 1.6-meter-long desk, and it also came with a private bathroom.

After coming out of the master bedroom, Ying Chanxi went into the other bathroom to take a look.

A girl's facial cleanser, toothpaste, toothbrush, cup, body wash, shampoo, towel, bath towel...

Hmm...

Ying Chanxi looked at these items, then pondered for a moment before walking to the living room, picking up Li Luo's schoolbag, and tossing it into the master bedroom.

"You can sleep in the master bedroom," Ying Chanxi said. "The master bedroom is too spacious, it's a bit scary to sleep in alone at night. I'll take a secondary bedroom."

After saying that, she dragged her own suitcase and chose the secondary bedroom next to the master bedroom, which was right between the study and the master bedroom, the closest room to it.

"Alright then." Li Luo didn't overthink it, simply assuming Ying Chanxi was being polite with him and felt too embarrassed to occupy the master bedroom as he was the landlord.

He placed his suitcase in the bedroom, then together with Zhao Rongjun, moved all of Ying Chanxi's large cardboard boxes into the secondary bedroom.

"You'll have to put away your own clothes, though. We can't help with that."

"I know." Ying Chanxi replied, preparing to sort her clothes. "Aren't you guys going to play basketball? You can go ahead."

"Okay." Li Luo moved his computer and other things into the master bedroom, placed them on the desk, and claimed it as his own.

He had sent his mom off early, not for the reasons his uncle had thought.

It was purely because he wanted to put the computer in his own room, making it more convenient to use.

If he had let his mom arrange things, it definitely wouldn't have turned out this way.

The next time his mom came over, even if she saw it, what's done is done. He would just have to say a few nice words, and it would blow over.

Thinking of this, Li Luo called Zhao Rongjun over, and they set up the computer together. Then he grabbed a basketball and his admission notice, planning to go check out the First Affiliated High School.

Before leaving, Li Luo glanced at the door to the study, wondering why the senior tenant hadn't come out to take a look.

But it was also possible she wasn't home.

Li Luo didn't think about it anymore. They would meet eventually anyway. So he set off with Zhao Rongjun.

And just as Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun left to play basketball, Xu Youyu, in the study, had just finished her nap and woken up from bed.

Still groggy, she got out of bed, shuffled to her desk, sat down, and opened QQ for a look.

Chong Ran

Has requested to add you as a friend

Awaiting verification

Her editor had sent her Chong Ran's QQ contact at noon, and Xu Youyu had added him.

But almost the entire afternoon had passed, and he still hadn't accepted.

She was now extremely curious about this boy her editor had described as being the same age as her. She really wanted to know what this person who was her contemporary and had written an alternate-universe entertainment novel was actually like.

She had read the book before and couldn't imagine how a 15-year-old boy could have written it.

It was a far cry from the middle-aged uncle author image she had previously imagined.

Xu Youyu patted her cheeks to wake herself up a bit, temporarily pushing the matter to the back of her mind. She then stood up and walked out of her room, wanting to use the restroom.

But as soon as she stepped out, she heard a sound from the bedroom next door and couldn't help but glance over.

In the bedroom, Ying Chanxi was putting away her clothes, placing them into the wardrobe one by one.

Hearing footsteps in the hallway outside her room, she looked up curiously and saw Xu Youyu.

"You are..." Xu Youyu remembered that the new landlord seemed to have mentioned that two of their kids would be staying over for the summer vacation, and that they were new first-year students at the First Affiliated High School this year.

It seemed that was supposed to be today, but Xu Youyu had forgotten, and she hadn't heard any commotion while sleeping earlier.

Seeing her now, Xu Youyu immediately showed a friendly smile, but after she took a closer look, she was suddenly taken aback:

"Are you... Are you that... Ying Chanxi?"

Being called by her full name, Ying Chanxi was also stunned. She then looked carefully at Xu Youyu's face and had a faint sense of recognition, asking hesitantly, "Are you Senior Xu?"

...

At the entrance of the First Affiliated High School.

Li Luo held a basketball in his arms, squinting as he looked up at the school buildings in the distance. His heart surged with emotion, filled with a myriad of feelings.

In his previous life, Li Luo was extremely unfamiliar with the First Affiliated High School.

In his memory, he had only passed by the school gates a few times, casting a casual glance.

Other than that, he had no further connection with this school.

But now, he was a new first-year student at the First Affiliated High School.

In another half a month, he would be studying at the top high school in Yinjiang District.

A huge turning point in his life was about to begin here.

"You've been standing here for several minutes." Zhao Rongjun wiped his forehead under the sun. "Is it really that interesting to look at?"

"I worked so hard to get into the First Affiliated High School. What's wrong with letting me look a little longer?"

"It's just an ordinary high school."

"Hah, a top student like you will never understand the world of an underachiever."

"You already got into the First Affiliated High School, aren't you a top student too?" Zhao Rongjun turned his head to correct him. "And you even received the Outstanding Graduate award from Yucai. I didn't even get that."

"...You've got a point."

Having admired it enough, Li Luo finally took a step forward and walked with Zhao Rongjun to the security guard's post at the gate.

Li Luo showed his admission notice, while Zhao Rongjun puffed out his chest, revealing the school emblem on his uniform.

The security guard didn't put up much of a fuss. After checking Li Luo's admission notice, he had them sign in with their names and let them in.

Once inside the First Affiliated High School, Zhao Rongjun had to lead the way.

Li Luo followed beside him, walking along the spacious asphalt road next to the school buildings, feeling as if the air itself was filled with the fragrance of knowledge.

"So this is the First Affiliated High School." Li Luo was like Grandma Liu visiting the Grand View Garden, looking left and right all the way, still a bit unused to the identity change from an underachiever to a top student.

Especially since he knew what his own level was.

Even with the memory palace helping him cheat, if he hadn't known the exam questions in advance, he probably wouldn't have been able to outscore the other students at the First Affiliated High School.

But he wouldn't think about that for now.

Li Luo saw the basketball court in the distance and smilingly patted Zhao Rongjun's shoulder, "Look, aren't there people playing basketball over there? The school's basketball court can't go to waste on the weekend."

As he said this, Li Luo had already quickened his pace toward it. "Perfect, we don't have to play one-on-one. We can just ask if they'll let two more join."

"Hey... wait." Zhao Rongjun followed behind. As they got closer, he saw the faces of the people on the court clearly and hurriedly said, "Li Luo, those guys are..."

"Hey! Classmates! Can we join you for a 3v3?" Li Luo didn't hear Zhao Rongjun's words and had already reached the side of the court, shouting to the four people playing.

After shouting, Li Luo noticed something and couldn't help but ask Zhao Rongjun beside him in a low voice, "Do all the students at the First Affiliated High School look this old? It's not easy being a top student, huh."

"..." Zhao Rongjun looked at him speechlessly. "Is it possible that they're teachers?"

"Holy crap, then they're pretty young."
